name: Clan Morna

attributes.attribute: followers of the warrior Goll Mac Morna
old rival clan that served Fionn Mac Comhaill
band formed when the two enemy clans joined

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Clan Morna is the name for the followers of the warrior Goll Mac Morna. They were the old rivals of the Clan Baíscne, who served the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. After a long run of skirmishes the two enemy clans came together to shape the band called the Fianna.

okr.objective: The Clan Morna was the war band of Goll, and its union with the Clan Baíscne created the Fianna.
key_results: The Clan Morna describes the followers of Goll Mac Morna.
The Clan Baíscne served the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
